A1.rationale: New Component Contracts and Failure Domains table names each component's interface, data ownership and fallback behaviour, closing the gap the baseline flagged.

A2.rationale: Cross-functional challenge table still names each agent, the alternative considered and why it was rejected or bounded instead.

A3.rationale: New Threat Model table states prompt-injection, exfiltration, hallucination, spoofing and drift scenarios against named boundaries with mitigations, closing the stated-threat-model gap.

A4.rationale: Still only design documents and a planned non-production demonstrator; no working implementation evidence exists anywhere in the changed files.

A5.rationale: New log-schema/correlation-ID envelope and named latency/failure-rate/cost metrics with a fixed measurement method move past purely qualitative discussion, though nothing is yet instrumented or measured.

A6.rationale: New AI Model Selection and Evaluation Harness section defines comparison criteria against smaller/larger models and a paired baseline evaluation harness with metrics and failure-mode taxonomy, though no model choice or evaluation has actually run.

A7.rationale: New Agent Orchestration Pattern section specifies a state-graph handoff, reflection/self-check step and tool-scoped authorization, a deliberate coordination design, but no autonomous behaviour is demonstrated.

B1.rationale: Board Decision Narrative connects problem, stakes, options and recommendation; no live delivery evidence exists to assess argument landing with an audience.

B2.rationale: Document explicitly designs explanations for resident, staff, funder/regulator/Board audiences, but this is written register calibration, not observed live delivery.

B3.rationale: No demo exists yet; only a plan for a future non-production demonstrator is described.

B4.rationale: Sponsor discovery questions anticipate challenge areas, but there is no live Q&A evidence to assess composure under pressure.

B5.rationale: No timed delivery or rehearsal evidence exists in the repository.

B6.rationale: Documentation grows denser with cross-referenced tables (Open Questions register, owner-direction cross-references) but remains reader-effort heavy with no accompanying slide deck.

B7.rationale: Owner-direction table adds quantified data points (grant coverage, missed-appointment threshold) but these are carefully labelled as owner statements, not new interpreted evidence or visuals.

C1.rationale: Stakeholders, constraints and quantified value at stake remain explicit and interrogated; new Open Questions register further names accountable functions per gap.

C2.rationale: Written role-agent challenge shows disagreement being recorded and addressed, but there is no live session evidence of real-time listening or disagreement navigation.

C3.rationale: Recommendation and risk disclosure remain clear; new risk row explicitly flags the danger of mistaking owner direction for verified evidence, reinforcing intellectual honesty.

D1.rationale: New scoring framework, threat model, evaluation harness and open-questions register are substantial original synthesis actionable by another architect, but still grounded in internal design work rather than direct company engagement evidence.

D2.rationale: Structured, cited and version-controlled with clear revision tracking, but still not a standalone publishable piece separate from the BRD/PRD apparatus.

D3.rationale: No publication, filing or external dissemination path is recorded anywhere in the repository; produced for the rubric and internal programme use only.
